query: Manama Bahrain taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: Official government tariff (effective March 18, 2026): BHD 1.000 to start on weekdays 06:00-22:00, or BHD 1.250 overnight and all day Fri/Sat/holidays, plus 200 fils per km for first half of journey and 250 fils per km for second half. Minimum fare BHD 2.000. A 5km Uber ride costs about 7 BHD.
